decisions.reason: As a flagship 2019 range close to the firm’s core safety-footwear business, it likely still has strategic option value and relatively low carrying cost, so management would be inclined to retain it unless performance has clearly disappointed.

This electrostatic-dissipative shoe is near the established offer and likely shares development and channel resources, so despite some risk of pruning within a broad portfolio, its niche compliance value supports keeping it for now.

Because this safety shoe series fits the firm’s main market and capabilities and the industry environment is favorable, management would more likely continue it than exit, though overlap with other models creates some rationalization risk.
